security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives from Markdown code fences and expected Minikube, kubectl, Docker, and YAML examples. I confirmed the privileged /etc/hosts update as a real high-risk local system change, and I found a low-risk issue with copyable placeholder secrets.

remediation.suggestion: Replace the sudo /etc/hosts example with port forwarding, minikube service, or minikube tunnel. If retained, require explicit confirmation and cleanup steps.
Use placeholders and tell users to replace values with generated secrets. Avoid reusable passwords in Secret manifests or command examples.
Explain that docker-env changes the current shell. Recommend trusted Minikube binaries and include minikube image load as an alternative.

content.value_statement: Local Kubernetes setup can be slow when cluster commands, images, and networking steps are scattered. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a focused Minikube workflow for setup, deployment, and debugging.
actual_capabilities: Starts and manages Minikube clusters with resource and driver options.
Enables common Minikube addons such as ingress, metrics-server, dashboard, and storage-provisioner.
Guides local image builds for Minikube and imagePullPolicy settings.
Provides kubectl commands for contexts, logs, events, rollout changes, and resource checks.
Supplies basic Deployment, Service, ConfigMap, Secret, and Ingress manifest examples.
Compares local service access through NodePort, tunnel, port forwarding, and ingress.
limitations: It assumes Minikube, Docker, and kubectl are already installed.
It focuses on local clusters, not production cloud Kubernetes operations.
It does not replace security review for secrets, RBAC, or network policy.
Some commands modify local cluster state and may require user confirmation.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Local Cluster
use_cases.description: Set up Minikube with useful addons, resource limits, and basic status checks before local development begins.

use_cases.title: Test Local Images
use_cases.description: Build Docker images for Minikube, deploy manifests, and verify that pods use local images correctly.

use_cases.title: Debug Local Workloads
use_cases.description: Inspect pods, events, logs, resource usage, and service connectivity when a local Kubernetes app fails.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Minikube Cluster
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me start a local Minikube cluster for a small web app. Include resource settings, required addons, and basic health checks.

prompt_templates.title: Deploy a Local Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through building a local Docker image, loading it into Minikube, and deploying it with local image pull settings.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a Restarting Pod
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to diagnose a pod that is restarting in Minikube. Ask for logs, events, probes, and resource checks.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Local Ingress Testing
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a local Kubernetes workflow for two services using Minikube ingress. Include verification steps, safer access options, and cleanup.

output_examples.input: My pod keeps restarting in Minikube.
output: A triage plan checks pod status, recent events, previous logs, probes, and resource usage.
The response separates cluster issues from application container failures.

output_examples.input: I need to test a local image without pushing to a registry.
output: The skill recommends a local image workflow for Minikube.
It reminds you to adjust image pull behavior before applying manifests.

output_examples.input: I need browser access to a local Kubernetes service.
output_examples.output: The response compares service URLs, port forwarding, tunnels, and ingress. It flags privileged host file changes as requiring explicit approval.

best_practices: Confirm the active kubectl context before applying manifests or changing namespaces.
Prefer port forwarding or service URLs for quick local tests before editing host files.
Replace all example secrets and passwords before using manifests in any shared cluster.
anti_patterns: Do not run local Kubernetes examples against a production cluster by accident.
Do not copy placeholder Secret values into reusable manifests.
Do not use sudo host file changes without explicit approval and rollback instructions.

faq.question: What tools does this skill assume?
faq.answer: It assumes Minikube, kubectl, and Docker are available on the local machine.

faq.question: Can it help with cloud Kubernetes clusters?
faq.answer: It is focused on local Minikube workflows. Cloud cluster setup is outside its main scope.

faq.question: Does it generate Kubernetes manifests?
faq.answer: It includes basic examples for Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, and Ingress resources.

faq.question: Can it debug failed pods?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides checks for pod details, events, logs, previous logs, probes, and resource usage.

faq.question: Does it need network access?
faq.answer: The documented examples test local cluster services. They do not require external endpoints.

faq.question: Are any commands sensitive?
faq.answer: Yes. Commands that edit /etc/hosts or change shell environment should be approved before use.
